paper.title: ChameleonTuner: Automatic ISP Color Tuning in Subjective Scenarios

source.readme_status: Stay Tunned, We will release the code soon!

method.misalignment_scope: limited FoV/PoV differences between simultaneous or paired captures
method.correspondence: LSC superpixels plus pretrained LoFTR keypoint aggregation
method.representative_colour: Gaussian blur plus within-region IQR filtering and mean
method.search_space: source-colour-supported LUT control vertices with clustered integer stride offsets

failure_reasons_for_current_mainline: requires same-scene source/target pairs rather than unrelated film and digital photographs
LoFTR and superpixel correspondences would reintroduce content/geometry dependence if used on unrelated archives
the public repository contains no implementation, checkpoint or licence
DPED and FiveK are digital camera/retouch controls, not film-stock truth
a reported one-day CPU search is not justified without an eligible paired target
reopen_condition: rights-cleared same-scene digital/film or scan-pipeline pairs with independent stock/roll/process groups, or an official licensed implementation plus an eligible paired non-stock method-control question
forbidden_rescues: treat visually similar unrelated images as pairs
use LoFTR match confidence as stock evidence
apply the method to current closed Commons/YFCC pixels
infer a film operator from DPED or FiveK
reimplement unpublished details and claim paper reproduction
start the one-day search without a new frozen eligible pair contract
claim_ceiling: current primary-source method and availability audit: region-level correspondence can relax geometric alignment only for same-scene paired colour calibration; it does not solve unpaired digital-to-film identification, provide film-stock evidence or open current implementation
